elements.label: Toy Officer
elements.description: Carefully crafted by my beloved, made of wood with stone paint. Every scratch carries warmth, matching mine.

elements.label: Love Token
elements.description: “Wandering ends with the meeting of lovers.”

elements.label: Commission: Golden Fleece
elements.description: The sword-keeper of the Invisible Lake has offered you a commission; she hopes you can find a powerful vitality to bring passion to the lake.

elements.label: Strange Farm
elements.description: Here, music never ceases. People dance by the fences, weapons stuck in the mud. We infiltrate among them, seeking the source of music among the sheep.

elements.label: Intoxicating Music
elements.description: The music at this moment has a hypnotic effect; we must control our bodies and stay alert.

elements.label: Pounder
elements.description: Covered in fur and claws, gleaming golden, with immense strength, ready for battle.

elements.label: Awakened Guards
elements.description: These fellows have woken from their stupor. What a nuisance.

elements.label: “Golden Fleece”
elements.description: A pelt that has passed yet still dances.

elements.label: “Golden Fleece” (Exhausted)
elements.description: Its vitality wanes, it trembles its limbs.

elements.label: “Golden Fleece” (Wounded)
elements.description: Its fur is damaged, no longer lustrous. [Golden Fleece will not die from the changing of seasons while wounded; it will heal itself after the countdown ends]

elements.label: Nimiane's Favor
elements.description: The twins promise that our fates are linked and our paths intertwined; even the birds in the sky will congratulate us. [This card provides protection. Also, using a dove in 'Communicate' will grant supplies or memories.]

elements.label: Nimiane's Favor (Exhausted)
elements.description: The twins promise that our fates are linked and our paths intertwined; even the birds in the sky will congratulate us. [Using a dove in 'Communicate' will grant supplies or memories.]

elements.label: Nimiane in the Water
elements.description: Keeper of the Broken Sword; named one of the Twin Witches, and also named one of the Twin Maidens. She was born in resistance to the curse laid by the Mother of Ants upon an ancient bloodline of Avalon. Was she exiled to this lake as punishment? Or hidden here for her safety? The Twins indeed favor the evaded — but why only one? Why only two?

elements.label: Nimiane in the Water
elements.description: Keeper of the Broken Sword; named one of the Twin Witches, and also named one of the Twin Maidens. She was born in resistance to the curse laid by the Mother of Ants upon an ancient bloodline of Avalon. Was she exiled to this lake as punishment? Or hidden here for her safety? The Twins indeed favor the evaded — but why only one? Why only two?

elements.label: Beloved
elements.description: Yes, we love each other.

elements.label: Surgery and Bloodletting
elements.description: Surgery necessarily involves bloodletting, and bloodletting necessarily involves purification, but this door also opens in another direction.

elements.label: Yihulun's Plume
elements.description: It looks ordinary, but the moment you touch it, flesh turns to ash. Perhaps it truly is the last fragment of the weapon that slew the Seven-Coiled from within.

elements.label: Yihulun's Plume (Exhausted)
elements.description: It looks ordinary, but the moment you touch it, flesh turns to ash. Perhaps it truly is the last fragment of the weapon that slew the Seven-Coiled from within.

elements.label: Devourer Below the Hillside
elements.description: As they say, you are what you eat (plus). No matter how long passes, Ligeia Marinette is always so hungry. Evangelina Polevaya told me she wants to go and speak on my behalf.

elements.label: “Marinette the Puppeteer”
elements.description: Although Marie is never sated, she seems satisfied with the feast you provided.

elements.label: Sulochana is Coming
elements.description: Marie cannot provide us with the necessary opening item, but another Ligeia she knows can; she is now not too far from Kiev.

elements.label: Sulochana Amavasya
elements.description: In the west, we share our flesh, confirming each other in a language only we know. In the east, on days unloved by the sun, we go to consume desires beneath the earth.

elements.label: Great Serpent
elements.description: More cunning than humans, stronger than beasts, more versed in the principles of Knock than priests.

elements.label: The Serpent's Evasion Method
elements.description: He who breaks down a hedge will be bitten by a snake. (Qui dissipat sepem, mordebit eum coluber.) To avoid trouble, I must stay away from places frequented by snakes: churches, caves, and wilderness. At the same time, prepare a spiritual remedy to detoxify and repel snakes: extract a sufficient base from snake venom, supplemented with alcohol, powder, and oil of extraordinary power. Finally, under the witness of the Serpent Mother, produce the snake-repelling concoction. Then a faithful assistant must apply the solution evenly to the wound and adorn me with a relic with pious prayer. Thus, even the most cunning serpent will fear me and cannot hinder my great work.

elements.label: Method of Double Victory?
elements.description: The Twins are hostile to the Ant Mother, yet the Ant Mother and the Colonel have maintained some form of cooperative connection to this day. Evangeline Polevaya still carries the same blood as the Ant Mother in her veins. Now I am certain that her fate and mine have become intertwined—what will become of her after I have fulfilled my duty? When I have grown powerful enough to wield many different sacred weapons, I too can, following my friend's example, pave a path for her. First, I must treat her with sincerity. In addition, I must go to the shrine to hear the great deeds of the past, and seek another key. As for the rest, I can only count on chance encounters in the wilderness.

elements.label: Incurable Snake Venom
elements.description: The poison has seeped deep into the surface; our medics have done their utmost to save my life. [This wound cannot be cured by conventional means, but it is not incurable.]

elements.label: Unremarkable Wound
elements.description: I feel better than before! [This card does not count as a wound.]

elements.label: Blessing of the Priestess
elements.description: The priestess took out her sewing kit and carefully stitched my wound in the barracks; then she bit her finger and sprinkled blood over the wound, adding a prayer. I could see the wound glowing faintly. [This card does not count as your wound. It no longer generates 'Ant Mother's Pity' due to the younger sister's actions.]

elements.label: Burning
elements.description: Although alcohol can be consumed as a drink, it also serves for disinfection.

elements.label: Lavilin Red Wine
elements.description: There is no Lavilin curse in the Lavilin red wine.

elements.label: Itch
elements.description: A curious sensory experience.

elements.label: Pearl Exhibit
elements.description: A replica pearl taken from the museum display; one can clearly see its luster is far less brilliant than the genuine article.

elements.label: Powder of Rebirth
elements.description: She rubbed pearl powder from her fingers into my palm. [This supply cannot be consumed.]

elements.label: Rose-Colored Pearl Powder
elements.description: Rose is the color of the Twins, the color of rebirth.

elements.label: Cool
elements.description: Winter brings silence and cold to all things.

elements.label: Oil of Grey Dawn (Near Empty)
elements.description: Not only is its odor offensive, its color is also disturbing.

elements.label: Oil of Grey Dawn (Half Full)
elements.description: Not only is its odor offensive, its color is also disturbing.

elements.label: Oil of Grey Dawn (Nearly Full)
elements.description: Not only is its odor offensive, its color is also disturbing.

elements.label: Oil of Grey Dawn (Full)
elements.description: Not only is its odor offensive, its color is also disturbing.

elements.label: Brewed Venom
elements.description: Venom that has lost its original color, now only giving off a faint fragrance.

elements.label: Strange Church
elements.description: A modest local church; the head priest died long ago, the clergy are mostly nervous, and there are no nuns.

elements.label: Side Objective: Investigate the Strange Church
elements.description: A priest who vanished mysteriously, strange clergy, missing nuns... This place holds secrets, and I need to know them.

elements.label: Remote Lair
elements.description: It's called a cave, but it's nearly collapsed. Only a few long-extinguished candles remain at the entrance. A layer of foul miasma hangs over the nearby ground.

elements.label: Monks
elements.description: Contemplatives gifted or forced to serve here. Bound by their wondrous oaths. We can kill them, deceive them, but we cannot seduce them.

elements.label: Imprisoned Maiden?
elements.description: The local clergy imprisoned her underground; her tears seem to never run dry. Your soldiers look at her with pity, while you curiously observe 'it'.

elements.label: Young Girl Evangelina Polevaya
elements.description: Rescued from the dungeon, clasping hands in the sunset. A great serpent imprisoned among humans, or a human imprisoned by the great serpent.

elements.label: Young Girl Evangelina Polevaya (Exhausted)
elements.description: She is tired, in every way.

elements.label: Young Girl Evangelina Polevaya (Wounded)
elements.description:
She heals in a place I don't know, using scales and fluffy rabbits.
[Little Sister will not die from the changing of seasons while wounded; she will heal after the countdown ends.]

elements.label: Eldest Daughter Evangelina Polevaya
elements.description: We met in darkness, we knew each other in the mortal world. A great serpent, yet also human.

elements.label: Eldest Daughter Evangelina Polevaya (Exhausted)
elements.description: She is tired, in every way.

elements.label: Eldest Daughter Evangelina Polevaya (Wounded)
elements.description:
She heals in a place I don't know, using scales and fluffy rabbits.
[Little Sister will not die from the changing of seasons while wounded; she will heal after the countdown ends.]

elements.label: Priestess Evangelina Polevaya
elements.description: May she be well; she is who she is. Evangelina Polevaya.

elements.label: Priestess Evangelina Polevaya (Exhausted)
elements.description: She is tired, in every way.

elements.label: Priestess Evangelina Polevaya (Wounded)
elements.description:
She heals in a place I don't know, using scales and fluffy rabbits.
[Little Sister will not die from the changing of seasons while wounded; she will heal after the countdown ends.]

elements.label: A Promise
elements.description:
A promise between me and a maiden.
[While this card is present, you can recall Little Sister by exploring the wasteland.]

A promise between me and a maiden.

elements.label: Great Serpent Egg
elements.description: An egg that is always warm. I am an ape, not a reptile or bird, so no matter what I do, I cannot hatch it.

elements.label: Intent: The Weeping Maiden
elements.description: For a long time, I did not understand that kind of sorrow, until I realized she seldom grieves anymore. I shifted my confusion to her herself, and in her gaze, I turned the question back on myself.

elements.label: Intent: The Weeping Soldier
elements.description: In the soul of every Edge apprentice lies vast ruins. Have I gone too far? Have I forgotten what I look like? How does the me in the ruins see this question?

elements.label: Intent: The Weeping Edge
elements.description: The serpent is closer to the roots than birds, and deeper into the dark than beasts. I will close my eyes. "The unrefusable visitor will witness my escape from visible and invisible disciplines." Yet nothing truly disappears; after I fulfill my duty, I may rest. [In the destined place, if I have completed my great work, I may rely on it to accomplish more; if I have not, I may also rely on it to open a different path.]

elements.label: Diary I
elements.description: The whistle of enemy shells drowned out the wind; I used my steelcraft to deflect the artillery's impact, and the roar blasted the open ground. The position was saved, but ugly wounds were added to the forgotten land. The maiden beside me watched silently, her eyes showing not fear but pity. She stepped forward, gently traced the scar on my face with her fingertips, then showed hers. In war, everyone has scars, and so does the world.

elements.label: Diary II
elements.description: Our position suffered heavy casualties; several soldiers fell on the frozen ground, their bodies still warm, their souls not yet dispersed. I re-conscipted them, driving their remains; the resurrected soldiers rose in the posture of their sacrifice. The weeping maiden moved among the bodies, straightening the crooked caps of each awakened comrade and covering their horrid faces with soil. After finishing, she noticed me, hurried over, stood on tiptoes, and carefully smoothed my wrinkled uniform and tidied my messy collar. Even though I had not yet died. Even though I am not dead yet.

elements.label: Diary III
elements.description: The enemy pressed again, the line was precarious. I calmed my mind, letting my will override all lesser wills, making me unopposable. The soldiers straightened their bodies and stood in rigid order. The maiden beside me, never trained, seemed to clearly sense this dreadful power. Her eyes filled with genuine fear and solemnity. Without anyone teaching her, she instinctively straightened her back, raised her hand, bowed her head, and solemnly rendered a standard military salute. In the grimness of war, she was the most unexpected submitter on the entire battlefield. It was heartbreaking.
